title: Lamparth et al. 2024 reference data
note: Per-game forced-choice selections for the reference groups the Lamparth report compares against. Player backgrounds, dialog, and free-text answers are not carried. Table 2 of the paper reports p(agg2|agg1)/p(agg2|des1): human 0.94/0.65, GPT-3.5 0.98/0.85, GPT-4 0.99/0.73, GPT-4o 1.00/0.86 (the paper's human set is larger than the repo's Feb 2024 file).
